title: Missing Afghan AN-24 Search and Rescue, Package
description: Package made from "Missing Afghan AN-24 Search and Rescue" in the B-roll section about the search and rescue mission for the Afghan-based Pamir Airlines commercial flight 122 which crashed in a mountain pass somewhere between Kunduz and Kabul in Afghanistan. Includes soundbite from Lt. Col. "Jeep" Willi, force flight lead, Combined Air Power Transition. Produced by Tech. Sgt. Mike Tateishi.
